description: Configuration schema for evaluating persona adapter performance and fidelity.

persona_fidelity.description: Measures how closely the generated output matches the target persona's stylistic signature.

knowledge_accuracy.description: Evaluates factual precision relative to the persona knowledge repository.

latency_ms.description: Inference time for adapter hot-swapping and generation.

alignment_drift.description: Quantifies performance degradation over time compared to the live target AI.
